package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

const FreshMigrationResultSchema = "course-migration-result.v1"

var (
	ErrMigrationTargetNotEmpty = errors.New("migration target is not empty")
	ErrMigrationFailed         = errors.New("migration failed")
)

// FreshMigrationResult is safe to persist in verification evidence. It never
// contains a connection string, database name, SQL text, or driver error.
type FreshMigrationResult struct {
	Schema          string `json:"schema"`
	Status          string `json:"status"`
	Reason          string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	MigrationCount  int    `json:"migration_count"`
	FailedMigration string `json:"failed_migration,omitempty"`
}

type freshMigrationRunner interface {
	QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) pgx.Row
	Exec(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error)
}

// RunFreshMigrations applies each forward SQL migration in lexical filename
// order to an empty public schema. It intentionally does not run seed files,
// tolerate SQL errors, or infer an already-applied migration set.
func RunFreshMigrations(ctx context.Context, runner freshMigrationRunner, migrationFS fs.FS) (FreshMigrationResult, error) {
	result := FreshMigrationResult{Schema: FreshMigrationResultSchema, Status: "failed"}
	if runner == nil || migrationFS == nil {
		result.Reason = "invalid_configuration"
		return result, errors.New("migration dependencies are incomplete")
	}

	var tables int
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public'`).Scan(&tables); err != nil {
		result.Reason = "database_unavailable"
		return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect fresh migration target: %w", err)
	}
	if tables != 0 {
		result.Reason = "target_not_empty"
		return result, ErrMigrationTargetNotEmpty
	}

	migrations, err := orderedForwardMigrations(migrationFS)
	if err != nil {
		result.Reason = "migration_directory_invalid"
		return result, err
	}
	for _, migration := range migrations {
		contents, err := fs.ReadFile(migrationFS, migration)
		if err != nil {
			result.Reason = "migration_directory_invalid"
			result.FailedMigration = filepath.Base(migration)
			return result, fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", filepath.Base(migration), err)
		}
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, string(contents)); err != nil {
			result.Reason = "migration_failed"
			result.FailedMigration = filepath.Base(migration)
			return result, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrMigrationFailed, filepath.Base(migration))
		}
		result.MigrationCount++
	}
	result.Status = "applied"
	return result, nil
}

func orderedForwardMigrations(migrationFS fs.FS) ([]string, error) {
	entries, err := fs.ReadDir(migrationFS, ".")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migrations directory: %w", err)
	}
	migrations := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		name := entry.Name()
		if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".sql") || strings.HasSuffix(name, ".down.sql") {
			continue
		}
		migrations = append(migrations, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(migrations)
	if len(migrations) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("no forward migrations found")
	}
	return migrations, nil
}
